name: deadline-buddy
description: Deadline Buddy - Installable PWA and Android App with Native Scheduled Alarms

scripts.build:www: powershell -Command "Copy-Item -Path *.html, *.png, manifest.json, service-worker.js -Destination www/ -Force; Copy-Item -Path css, js, images, webfonts -Destination www/ -Recurse -Force"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:www && cap sync android
